summary: Validates a double-indirected pointer as a well-formed C++ exception record header: exception code 0xE06D7363 at record +0x0, NumberParameters == 3 at +0x10, magic 0x19930520 in ExceptionInformation[0] at +0x14, and no nested continuation (ExceptionInformation[2] == 0 at +0x1C). Returns TRUE only when all four checks pass, otherwise FALSE.

operations.description: Load the exception record pointer v1 from the double-indirected argument (*a1).
Guard: exception code at record +0x0 equals 0xE06D7363, the MSVC C++ exception signature.
Guard: ExceptionInformation[0] at record +0x14 equals the magic 0x19930520.
Guard: ExceptionInformation[2] at record +0x1C is zero, meaning there is no nested continuation record.
Return the logical AND of all four checks: TRUE when every guard passes, FALSE otherwise.
Called by SEHWrapperAroundCRTFunctionCall (0x005938B4) as the gate before dispatch through the C++ exception path.

unresolved: The EXCEPTION_RECORD layout is inferred from the field offsets 0x0/0x10/0x14/0x1C; the record pointer itself is supplied by the caller.
The interpretation of ExceptionInformation[2] as a nested-continuation pointer is DERIVED from the zero-check pattern, not proven by the raw source.
